ld_json.headline: Vertex CGI’s Viral NBA Finals Video in 5 Days
ld_json.description: Vertex CGI, a studio behind more than 25 billion organic views across 1,200+ campaigns, used Higgsfield throughout a five day sprint to take the NBA Finals celebration video from first call to publish, a timeline in which a traditional, AI free pipeline would have produced roughly five times fewer shots with the same team.

Cannes Lions Winner Purga Builds AI Film Worlds
ld_json.description: An AI creative studio that works, in its own words, in an artisanal way: how PURGA fixed characters and visual direction first, built the world around them in Cinema Studio, and carried that pipeline to a Bronze Lion in Film at Cannes Lions 2026.

ld_json.headline: Brilliance Cuts Production Costs by 80%
70% of BITT Animation’s Work Now Uses AI
ld_json.description: BITT Animation has produced VFX for PepsiCo, Toyota and Coca-Cola for 24 years. Now 70% of its work involves AI, six major projects run in parallel where one did before, and fully generative jobs land at 15–20% of a traditional budget. CCO Gonzalo Canepa explains how a studio built on Maya and Nuke rebuilt itself around Higgsfield.

ld_json.headline: Sasha Kasiuha: The Image Still Needs an Author
ld_json.description: Creative director Sasha Kasiuha has built images for Madonna, Dolce & Gabbana, Maison Margiela and Tom Ford. In this conversation he explains where Higgsfield enters high-fashion image-making — from testing worlds before a shoot to invisible AI inserts in the edit — and why authorship, not generation, remains the real craft.

ld_json.headline: Sinecera Runs Hybrid Production for Lacoste & More
ld_json.description: Sinecera shoots conventionally, produces full AI, and runs hybrid — commercials for Lacoste and SuperStep, a century of Turkish racing for Nesine, all built inside Higgsfield's Cinema Studio.

ld_json.headline: AdQUA Cuts Production Costs by 97% with Higgsfield
ld_json.description: AdQUA Interactive, one of Korea’s leading independent digital agencies, and brand-building company Boosterz talk about the pain points that led them to Higgsfield, why quality decided it, and what happens when a whole organization can execute every idea it has.

ld_json.description: Alex Shalson built the first official Maradona apparel brand world using Higgsfield, sold out in three weeks and reached over ten million people. Here is how One of One uses AI as a creative instrument, not a shortcut.

ld_json.headline: Boxel Studio Brings AI into Pre-Production
ld_json.description: Boxel Studio, the animation and VFX team behind Superman & Lois and The Lincoln Lawyer, used Higgsfield Cinema Studio to cut pre-production from months to days. The studio ran look development and visual prototyping on Higgsfield while keeping artists in full control and meeting Hollywood-level standards for client confidentiality and IP protection.
